stacking.note: StackWise Virtual pairs two fixed Catalyst 9500 high-performance switches over dedicated SVL links. Not compatible with StackWise-480 or StackWise-1T rear stacking

routing.summary: Full L3 incl. BGP, VRF, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, and SD-Access (Network Advantage)

routeScale: Up to 256,000 IPv4 indirect+direct (UADP 3.0 high-performance models; SDM dependent)
macTable: Up to 82,000 (UADP 3.0 high-performance models; SDM dependent)
buffer: Up to 36 MB unified buffer per UADP 3.0 ASIC

redundancy.detail: Two field-replaceable PSU slots; second supply sold separately

licensing: Cisco DNA or Cisco Networking Subscription (Essentials or Advantage) required with purchase
